_readme: Community tools shown on belpire.com/star-citizen/. Edit freely: url must be https; kind is one of web, app, overlay, extension, game-file. 'releases' shows the latest GitHub release; the repo must also be listed in TRACKED_REPOS in worker/star-citizen.js.

categories.name: Install on your PC
categories.blurb: Quality-of-life downloads. Get them only from these official links.

tools.name: StarStrings
tools.description: Community global.ini that adds [BP] tags to blueprint contracts, lists contract rewards, prefixes components with type, size and grade, and shortens mining names.
tools.note: Check for an update after every patch, or contracts can show blank text.

tools.name: Smart Citizen
tools.description: Windows app that manages the game's localization files: switch languages and apply readability enhancements, with install detection built in.
tools.note: The installer isn't code-signed. After updating, run Generate Enhancements, then Apply Enhancements.

tools.name: Arkanis Overlay
tools.description: Open-source in-game overlay: a command palette that looks things up in community tools without alt-tabbing.

categories.footnote: StarStrings and Smart Citizen both change the game's localization file, so pick one.

tools.name: Erkul DPS Calculator
tools.description: Build, compare and share ship loadouts with DPS, shields and power numbers.

tools.name: SPViewer
tools.description: Ship performance compared side by side: speed, acceleration, quantum travel and more.

tools.name: Universal Item Finder
tools.description: Find where to buy any weapon, component or armor, with full stats.

tools.name: UEX
tools.description: Crowd-sourced commodity prices, trade and mining routes, and refinery planning.

tools.name: SC Trade Tools
tools.description: Trade route finder, commodity prices and a mining refinery calculator.

tools.name: SC Hauling Tools
tools.description: Orders your hauling contract stops to cut backtracking; can import contracts by screenshot.

tools.name: SCMDB
tools.description: Mission, blueprint, crafting and resource database for the current patch.

tools.name: VerseGuide
tools.description: Find any location in the 'verse, from outposts to caves.

tools.name: VerseTime
tools.description: Local time of day at landing zones and outposts, so you know if you're landing in the dark.

tools.name: Star Binder
tools.description: Search and edit your keybinds in the browser.

tools.name: FleetYards
tools.description: Ship database and fleet tracker for you and your org.

tools.name: CCU Game
tools.description: Plan ship upgrade (CCU) chains and manage your hangar; works with a browser extension.

tools.name: Star Citizen Wiki
tools.description: The community wiki: ships, items, locations and mechanics.
